title: Activation of X-Succinate Synthases for Fumarate Hydroalkylation Using an In Vitro Activation Method

steps.title: Prepare LB media
steps.instruction: Make 1 L LB by adding 20 g LB powder to 1 L Milli‑Q water, mix, and autoclave on a standard liquid cycle (25 min).

steps.title: Prepare LB‑agar plates
steps.instruction: Make 25 mL LB‑agar (1.5 % w/v agar) by adding 375 mg agar to 25 mL LB, autoclave (25 min), cool to ~50 °C, add antibiotic (100 µL ampicillin stock for 100 µg mL⁻¹ or 100 µL kanamycin stock for 50 µg mL⁻¹), mix, pour into plates.

steps.title: Prepare 50 % glycerol stock
steps.instruction: Combine 50 mL glycerol with 50 mL Milli‑Q water, mix to 100 mL (50 % v/v). Autoclave only if the stock will be used for glycerol‑stock of strains; otherwise store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare TB media
steps.instruction: Dissolve 47.6 g TB powder in 1 L water, add 8 mL 50 % glycerol stock, autoclave (25 min).

steps.title: Prepare antibiotic stocks
steps.instruction: Make 10 mL kanamycin (50 mg mL⁻¹, 1 000×) and 10 mL ampicillin (100 mg mL⁻¹, 1 000×) by dissolving the indicated mass in Milli‑Q water, aliquot, and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare iron and cysteine stocks
steps.instruction: Dissolve 75 mg Fe(II) ammonium sulfate hexahydrate in 1 mL water (75 mg mL⁻¹, 1 000×) and filter (0.22 µm). Dissolve 23.5 mg L‑cysteine·HCl in 1 mL water (23.5 mg mL⁻¹, 1 000×) and filter (0.22 µm). Store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare IPTG stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 2.383 g IPTG in water and bring volume to 10 mL (1 M). Aliquot and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare HEPES and imidazole stocks
steps.instruction: Make 1 L 1 M HEPES (238.3 g), adjust pH to 8.0 with NaOH, store at 4 °C. Make 1 L 2 M imidazole (136.2 g), adjust pH to 8.0 with HCl, store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare buffer solutions
steps.instruction: Using the stocks above, prepare the following buffers (store cold, sparge with N₂ for 20 min, keep in the anaerobic chamber):

substeps.instruction: Lysis/equilibration buffer (500 mL): 25 mL 1 M HEPES (50 mM), 30 mL 5 M NaCl (300 mM), 50 mL 50 % glycerol (5 %), water to 500 mL. (Add 10 mM imidazole if using Ni Sepharose.)
Wash buffer (500 mL): same as above plus 1.25 mL 2 M imidazole (5 mM) (or 20 mM imidazole for Ni Sepharose).
Elution buffer (500 mL): same as above plus 50 mL 2 M imidazole (200 mM) (or 300 mM for Ni Sepharose).
Desalting/activation buffer (500 mL): 25 mL 1 M HEPES (50 mM), 30 mL 5 M NaCl (300 mM), water to 500 mL.

steps.title: Transform plasmids into E. coli
steps.instruction: Thaw 100 µL chemically competent NiCo21(DE3) on ice (5–10 min), add 10–50 ng plasmid (pET‑DUET‑BSSαβγ, pRSF‑DUET‑BSSβ, or pET‑28a‑IbsAE), incubate on ice 30 min, heat‑shock 42 °C for 45 s, return to ice 4 min, add 500 µL SOC, recover 37 °C, 220 rpm, 1 h.

steps.title: Plate transformed cells
steps.instruction: Plate 100 µL recovery culture on LB‑agar plates containing the appropriate antibiotic (50 µg mL⁻¹ kanamycin or 100 µg mL⁻¹ ampicillin), spread, incubate upside‑down 37 °C, 16–18 h. Store plates at 4 °C (≤2 weeks).

steps.title: Inoculate starter culture
steps.instruction: Pour 100 mL LB into a 500 mL Erlenmeyer flask, add 100 µL appropriate antibiotic stock, inoculate with a single colony, incubate 37 °C, 220 rpm, overnight (12–16 h).

steps.title: Set up expression cultures
steps.instruction: In a 2.8 L Fernbach flask add 1 L pre‑sterilized LB (for BSSβ/αγ) or TB (for IbsAE) plus 1 mL antibiotic stock, 1 mL Fe(II) ammonium sulfate stock, 1 mL L‑cysteine stock; inoculate with 10 mL starter culture.

steps.title: Grow expression cultures to mid‑log
steps.instruction: Incubate at 37 °C, 220 rpm until OD₆₀₀ = 0.6–0.8 (≈2.5–4 h). Measure OD₆₀₀ by transferring 0.75–1 mL culture to a cuvette and reading at 600 nm.

steps.title: Cold shock before induction
steps.instruction: Transfer flasks to 4 °C (cold room or ice bath) for 30 min.

steps.title: Induce protein expression
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL 1 M IPTG stock to each 1 L culture (final 100 µM), reduce temperature to 22 °C, shaking to 100 rpm, incubate 12–16 h.

steps.title: Harvest cells
steps.instruction: Transfer cultures to centrifuge bottles, spin 2 700 × g, 4 °C, 30 min, discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 30 mL lysis/equilibration buffer (per 2 L culture) in a 50 mL conical tube, spin 2 700 × g, 4 °C, 20 min, discard supernatant, flash‑freeze pellets in liquid N₂, store –80 °C.

steps.title: Anaerobic cell lysis
steps.instruction: Inside an N₂‑filled anaerobic chamber, thaw frozen pellets 30–60 min, add 40 mg lysozyme (≈1 mg mL⁻¹ final) dissolved in 40 mL lysis/equilibration buffer, add 25 µL DNase I (2.5 MU mL⁻¹), resuspend, optionally add protease inhibitor, add pre‑chilled (‑20 °C) cold beads, sonicate 2 × 2 min (2 s on/2 s off, amplitude 20 %).

steps.title: Clarify lysate
steps.instruction: Transfer sonicated lysate in sealed tubes out of the chamber, centrifuge 14 000 × g, 4 °C, 45 min, immediately return tubes to the chamber, carefully collect brown supernatant (avoid debris), optionally filter (0.22 µm).

steps.title: Immobilized‑metal affinity chromatography
steps.instruction: Pack 1 mL TALON® (or Ni‑Sepharose) resin in a gravity‑flow column, equilibrate with 15–20 CV lysis/equilibration buffer, load clarified lysate, collect flowthrough for SDS‑PAGE, wash with 20 CV wash buffer, discard first 500 µL elution buffer, then elute protein with 2.5 mL elution buffer (collect brown eluate).

steps.title: Desalt and exchange buffer
steps.instruction: In the anaerobic chamber, set up a PD‑10 column wrapped in parafilm, equilibrate with 25 CV desalting/activation buffer, load 2.5 mL IMAC eluate, elute with 3.5 mL desalting/activation buffer into a conical tube.

steps.title: Concentrate purified protein
steps.instruction: Transfer eluate to an appropriate centrifugal filter (50 kDa for BSSαγ, 10 kDa for IbsAE/BSSβ), spin at 4 000 × g, 4 °C, 5 min intervals until volume is 250–500 µL (target concentrations: IbsAE 200–375 µM, BSSαγ 150–300 µM, BSSβ 400–800 µM).

steps.title: Aliquot and store protein
steps.instruction: Mix concentrated protein, take a small aliquot for SDS‑PAGE and concentration measurement, dispense remaining protein into 50–100 µL aliquots, cycle out of the chamber, plunge into liquid N₂, store at –80 °C.

steps.title: SDS‑PAGE analysis of purification
steps.instruction: Take 10 µL flowthrough, 10 µL wash, 1 µL concentrated protein (dilute with 9 µL water), add 5 µL loading dye, heat 95 °C 2 min, load onto 4–20 % gel, run 270 V 25 min, stain with SimplyBlue (microwave 1 min, shake 10 min), destain with water ~30 min, compare bands to standards (BSSαγ 99.0/6.9 kDa, IbsAE 40.3 kDa, BSSβ 11.7 kDa).

steps.title: Determine protein concentration
steps.instruction: Cycle 4 µL protein into a UV‑Vis microplate, add 4 µL water blanks, measure A₂₈₀, subtract blank, calculate concentration using Beer‑Lambert (C = A₂₈₀ / ε · 1/b) with ε values: IbsAE 36 900 M⁻¹ cm⁻¹, BSSαγ 141 150 M⁻¹ cm⁻¹, BSSβ 17 990 M⁻¹ cm⁻¹.

steps.title: Set up activation reaction (300 µL)
steps.instruction: In a 1.7 mL tube inside the anaerobic chamber add 110.7 µL desalting/activation buffer, 3 µL 100 mM DTT (final 1 mM), 6 µL 10 mM 5‑deazariboflavin (final 50 µM), 76.2 µL IbsAE (197 µM stock, final 50 µM), 91.6 µL BSSαγ (164 µM stock, final 50 µM), and finally 12.5 µL 36 mM AdoMet (final 1.5 mM). Mix gently (pipette up/down three times, no air).

steps.title: Incubate activation reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate the sealed tube at 25 °C for 3–24 h in a metal heat block; ensure exposure to light (fluorescent lamp in MBraun chamber or ambient light in Coy chamber).

steps.title: Monitor activation by SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Cycle 1 µL activation reaction and 1 µL unactivated BSSαγ control out of the chamber, add 24 µL water to each, transfer 5 µL of each to new tubes, add 5 µL loading dye, heat 95 °C 2 min, run on 7.5 % gel (2 µL ladder, 4 µL sample), 270 V 25 min, stain as above. Expect a single 99.0 kDa band for control and both 99.0 kDa and 93.3 kDa bands for activated sample.

steps.title: Quantify glycyl radical by EPR
steps.instruction: Prepare Fremy’s salt standards (5–50 µM final) in desalting/activation buffer, record stock concentration, transfer 250–300 µL of activation reaction and each standard into EPR tubes, freeze rapidly in liquid N₂, bring tubes out on liquid N₂, collect spectra (120 K, center field 3320 G, sweep 200 G, 60 s, gain 60 dB, modulation 3 G, microwave 1.26 µW). Optimize power (two‑fold difference) and overlay spectra. Use Xenon software to double‑integrate, plot standard curve (integral vs. Fremy’s concentration), calculate glycyl‑radical concentration of the activation sample.

steps.title: Set up hydroalkylation reaction (50 µL)
steps.instruction: In the anaerobic chamber add 5.7 µL desalting/activation buffer, 1 µL 100 mM fumarate stock (final 2 mM), 0.5 µL neat toluene (final 1 % v/v), 2.8 µL BSSβ (723 µM stock, final 40 µM), and 40 µL of the previously prepared activation reaction (containing 50 µM activated BSSαγ). Mix gently.

steps.title: Incubate hydroalkylation reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate the sealed tube at 25 °C for ~1 h (room temperature) on a heat block; mix gently three times by pipetting without introducing air.

steps.title: Quench reaction
steps.instruction: Remove tube from anaerobic chamber, add 50 µL methanol to quench.

steps.title: Add internal standard
steps.instruction: Add 2 mM 3‑chlorobenzoic acid solution (stock from Recipe 23) in a 1:1 (v/v) ratio to the quenched mixture (i.e., 50 µL internal standard to 100 µL total).

steps.title: Prepare sample for LC‑MS
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at max speed 20 min, decant supernatant, dilute 20‑fold with Milli‑Q water, filter through a 0.22 µm syringe filter (or 96‑well filter plate).

steps.title: Prepare LC‑MS standard curve
steps.instruction: From 20 mM benzylsuccinic acid stock (Recipe 24) make serial dilutions to obtain 2.5 mM, 1.25 mM, 0.625 mM, 0.3125 mM, 0.15625 mM, 0.07813 mM, 0.03906 mM, 0.01953 mM, 0.00977 mM, 0.00488 mM. Pipette 50 µL of each into a 96‑well plate, add equal volume of 2 mM 3‑chlorobenzoic acid (1:1 v/v), add 50 µL methanol, dilute 20‑fold with water, filter as above.

steps.title: Run LC‑MS/MS analysis
steps.instruction: Inject 10 µL of each sample onto a CORTECS Premier C18+ (2.1 × 50 mm, 1.6 µm) column using Waters Acquity Premier UPLC‑MS. Mobile phase A: water + 0.1 % formic acid; B: acetonitrile + 0.1 % formic acid. Gradient: 0 min 5 % B, 1.5 min 95 % B, 2.3 min 95 % B, 2.5 min 5 % B, 3.0 min 5 % B. Flow 0.8 mL min⁻¹. Detect in negative ESI mode, monitor m/z 207.1 (benzylsuccinate) and 155.1 (3‑chlorobenzoic acid) in SIR. Use the standard curve to calculate product concentration and assay yield (% = [product]/[limiting reagent] × 100).
